name: Open Wrap
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: NexusPoint Wrapped Nexus symbol refinement, a clean concept preview. Input image 1 is the existing logo symbol and is the identity reference. Create ONE variation of this exact symbol family, not a different brand. Preserve a readable uppercase N silhouette, the diagonal wrapped ribbon twisting around ONE central circular blue connection point, and the visual pull inward to the point. White filled ribbon shapes, central dot portfolio blue #02A1E1. Flat two-colour logo artwork with crisp smooth vector-like boundaries, even curves, practical at favicon sizes. Fully transparent background. The whole symbol must be centred with generous clear margin on every side, occupy about 65% of a square canvas. No lettering, no wordmark, no labels, no border or enclosing square, no mockup, no lighting, no gradients, no 3D, no textures, no extra dots, no generic infinity icon, no embellishments. The source feels too boxed: remove the rigid square perimeter while retaining recognition and the same centre-wrap concept. Direction 1, Open Wrap. This should be the closest evolution of the reference. Make the two vertical stems about 20% slimmer and subtly shorter. Trim the four outer terminals with confident oblique cuts, softly rounded joins, stagger the extremities so the outer outline no longer describes a square. Retain the two opposing folded arcs around the dot and the small diagonal negative-space seams. Widen the opening around the dot slightly so the mark breathes. Keep strong structural N readability and a balanced sober geometric form.
